spanish: Por tanto tú y toda tu congregación, los congregados sobre Jehová; y Aarón, ¿qué es él, que sobre él?

findings.issue: Verbless clause מה הוא has no copula token; Spanish inserts unmarked es. A copula that only makes the clause a sentence must be marked (*es*).

notes: Remaining tokens match: address, congregation, niphal gathered-ones, על left open as sobre, Jehová, Aarón, and כי as que.
